key_findings: T6I survives all staged gates without falling
Drift is bounded and non-accumulating at all heights
Drift at high_0p480 is one-sided positive (95.6%) and not centered at zero
T6I convergence mechanism activates only 5-9% of steps with limited impact
low_0p380 has a marginal 0.0005m transient that self-corrects
No WBC, hidden torque, or ownership violations in any run
No falls in any configuration across 30,000+ total simulated steps
low_0p300 shows no regression over 5000 steps; drift improves over time
comparison_vs_t6f: T6I is broadly comparable to T6F. Not clearly superior. Both provide bounded drift at similar magnitudes.
step_e_readiness: Stable but not precise. Passes hard gates but drift is one-sided and T6I mechanism impact is limited.
next_steps: Decide whether Step E requires centered drift or only bounded drift
